title: The Audit Barrage, Wired Into Every Task
description: The audit barrage is deskwork’s third independent audit surface — multiple model families reviewing the same diff in parallel, beyond the in-band self-audit and the two-reviewer cycle. How it became an unconditional end-of-task hook in /dwi with teeth (a single verb plus commit-msg and pre-push gates), a dampener that decides slush-vs-promote, and what the Phase 12 self-dogfood caught that the others missed.
